title: Cranioplasty by reconstruction material in Germany, 2019–2024: analysis code
description: Analysis code, input-file templates and validation script for a nationwide study of cranioplasty in Germany (2019–2024) based on aggregate §21 KHEntgG discharge data from the InEK DatenBrowser. The code computes national volumes, case mix, in-hospital mortality and coded infection for autologous (OPS 5-020.2), simple alloplastic (5-020.70) and computer-aided-design (5-020.71/.72/.74/.75) cranioplasty. A sensitivity analysis quantifies episodes coded with both an autologous and an alloplastic procedure. The InEK data are not redistributed.
